newsitem.title: USA: Maxim sees Q1 below analysts' estimates.
newsitem.headline: Maxim sees Q1 below analysts' estimates.

text.p: Maxim Group Inc said it expects earnings for its first quarter to be lower than analysts' consensus estimates by about $.03 to $.04 per share.
Consenus estimates are about $0.08 per share for the April 30 quarter, according to First Call.

The company said the earnings shortfall is due to higher than expected sample costs in its manufacturing division and lower builder sales within the retail division, partially offset by better than expected performance in franchise operations and lower than expected SG&A expenses within the retail division.
